_comment: Corex Panel Preconfigured Template: FiveM FXServer with txAdmin
name: Corex FiveM FXServer (txAdmin)
author: support@corexpanel.com
description: High-performance FiveM FXServer with integrated txAdmin web panel, auto-installer, and MariaDB automated provisioning.
startup: /bin/bash /opt/cfx-server/run.sh +set txAdminPort {{TXADMIN_PORT}} +set serverProfile default +set txAdminInterface 0.0.0.0 +set sv_maxclients {{MAX_PLAYERS}} +set steam_webApiKey "{{STEAM_WEBAPIKEY}}" +set sv_licenseKey "{{FIVEM_LICENSE}}"

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Corex FiveM Automated Installer with txAdmin
apt update
apt install -y curl tar xz-utils jq

cd /mnt/server
mkdir -p /mnt/server/alpine

echo "Fetching FiveM FXServer build: ${FIVEM_ARTIFACT}..."
if [ "${FIVEM_ARTIFACT}" = "latest" ] || [ "${FIVEM_ARTIFACT}" = "recommended" ]; then
    DOWNLOAD_URL=$(curl -s https://runtime.fivem.net/artifacts/fivem/build_provisional/ | grep -o 'https://runtime.fivem.net/artifacts/fivem/build_provisional/[0-9]*-.*fx.tar.xz' | head -n 1)
    if [ -z "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" ]; then
        DOWNLOAD_URL="https://runtime.fivem.net/artifacts/fivem/build_provisional/server.7290.fx.tar.xz"
    fi
else
    DOWNLOAD_URL="https://runtime.fivem.net/artifacts/fivem/build_provisional/${FIVEM_ARTIFACT}.fx.tar.xz"
fi

echo "Downloading from ${DOWNLOAD_URL}..."
curl -sSL "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" -o fx.tar.xz
tar -xvf fx.tar.xz -C /mnt/server/alpine
rm -f fx.tar.xz

ln -sfn /mnt/server/alpine/run.sh /mnt/server/run.sh
chmod +x /mnt/server/run.sh /mnt/server/alpine/run.sh /mnt/server/alpine/FXServer

echo "Corex FiveM txAdmin installation complete!"
